integrity: All all-length conclusions have an analytic proof; finite tests support reproducibility and are not substituted for proof. Historical literature screening is incomplete and expert review has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Three rails, unit longitudinal weights, uniform rational rung weight at least one, and one unrestricted vertex input only; excludes irrational detunings, nonuniform edges, energy and conditioning.
title: Complete rational-rung controllability ranks on three-rail path grids
